blurb: Escape the pace of the city in our cozy outdoor garden retreat designed for movement, mindfulness, and connection. By day, the space transforms into an energizing open-air setting for flow yoga and wellness sessions surrounded by calming natural ambiance. By evening, the garden glows with candlelight for guided meditation, sound baths, and restorative experiences designed to help you fully unwind.
